name: Night Shifts in Silence
source:
A favor called in, a week's worth of night shifts at a corner convienence store. Paried with a chill co-worker, seeing little foot traffic. A few quiet nights to let time pass by. 

Right?

[From [url=https://gray-lofi.itch.io/night-shifts-in-silence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接到一个帮忙，在街角便利店做了一周的夜班。与一位冷漠的同事并肩而行，看到人流量很少。几个安静的夜晚，让时间流逝。

正确的？
